# {{< meta course >}} · Day 1 {.course-day-slide}

Monday, September 14, 2026

# Arrive Every Day

- Sit down and relax.
- Take a look at the quote.
- Phones are okay until attendance is finished.
- No talking while attendance is being taken.
- When your name is called, say **"here"** or something else loud enough for me to hear.

::: {.big-prompt}
If I do not hear you **and** see you, I cannot mark you present.
:::

# Why do this?

::: {.big-prompt}
Why do you think we start class this way?
:::

# Attendance & Participation

::: {.big-prompt}
**Physically present:** required.  
**Mentally present:** your choice, but it affects your participation and learning.
:::

- Attendance and participation are part of your course grade.
- Participation includes **in-class** and **online** participation. More on online participation later.
- Lateness, repeated or extended time out of class, and avoiding participation all count.
- Making it harder for someone else to be present and learn also counts.

**Participation is a significant part of the grade.**

# Essential Expectations

- Respect **transition times and timers**.
- Respect **no-phone** moments.
- Respect **no-talking** moments.
- Do not prevent other people from learning.

::: {.big-prompt}
Otherwise, I am very flexible. This class should be a lot of fun.
:::

# Very Difficult to Fail

::: {.big-prompt}
If you submit your work, it is very difficult to fail my class.
:::

- The main way to fail is to submit **little or nothing**.
- More importantly: do not prevent other people from learning.

# Any Questions?

::: {.big-prompt}
Ask now. Ask later. Ask when you need help.
:::

# Announcements {.announcements-slide}

- Welcome to the course!

# Today's Route

- **10-15 min:** Entering flow state - name game
- Build something and document it.
- Submit a **PDF** on Google Classroom.
- **Final 15 min:** quiet reflection and daily log.

# Entering Flow: Name Game

**10-15 minutes**

1. Say your **preferred name**.
2. Add one simple **action or gesture**.
3. The next person repeats a few names/actions before adding their own.
4. Help each other if someone gets stuck.

::: {.big-prompt}
Learn names, move around, and get comfortable working together.
:::

# Name Tag V1

::: {.big-prompt}
Make a clear, useful name tag that helps me learn your name.
:::

**5-10 minutes**

# Document + Submit

1. Take a **clear, well-lit photo** of your name tag.
2. Put the photo in a Google Doc or other software that can create a PDF.
3. Crop and resize it so the name tag is easy to read.
4. Add: **Submitted by: your-student-number**
5. Export as a **PDF**, open it, and check it.
6. Submit the PDF to **Google Classroom**.

# Mission Complete

- Name tag is clear and easy to read.
- Photo is clear and well-lit.
- PDF includes **Submitted by: your-student-number**.
- PDF opens and looks correct.
- PDF is submitted to Google Classroom.
- Physical name tag goes home and comes back usable.
